events.subtitle: Celebrating the 25th Anniversary of Chihiro Yamanaka's Debut — New York Trio
events.category: Japanese jazz / piano trio / 25th-anniversary album tour
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Chihiro Yamanaka New York Trio on October 15 and 16, 2026, celebrating 25 years since the start of her recording career. Each night has sets starting at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM, with doors at 5:00 PM and 7:45 PM respectively. The venue lists Chihiro Yamanaka on piano, Yoshi Waki on bass and John Davis on drums, with a ¥9,900 music charge. Universal Music Japan confirms that Happy-Go-Lucky is released September 30, 2026, marks Yamanaka's 25-year music career, uses the same Yamanaka/Waki/Davis personnel, and that the October 15-16 Blue Note Tokyo engagement opens the announced tour behind the album. The record draws on repertoire Yamanaka has performed across her career, combining piano and keyboard with the trio's groove and interplay.

en.why_it_matters: The anniversary has a musical shape, not just a number: Yamanaka opens the Happy-Go-Lucky tour with Yoshi Waki and John Davis, the same New York Trio heard on an album built from repertoire she has carried and reshaped across twenty-five years of live work. That makes these Blue Note dates a compact snapshot of where one of Japan's most distinctive contemporary jazz pianists has arrived, with the trio's groove and close interplay doing the storytelling.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the four sets if October 15-16 overlaps a Tokyo stay. Two nights give enough flexibility to build an Aoyama evening around the trio without reorganizing the wider Kanto itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: El aniversario tiene una forma musical, no sólo una cifra: Yamanaka abre la gira de Happy-Go-Lucky con Yoshi Waki y John Davis, el mismo New York Trio del disco, construido a partir de repertorio que ella ha tocado y transformado a lo largo de veinticinco años de trabajo en vivo. Estas fechas condensan muy bien el punto al que ha llegado una de las pianistas más singulares del jazz japonés contemporáneo, con el groove y la interacción cerrada del trío contando la historia.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets si el 15 o 16 de octubre coincide con una estancia en Tokio. Las dos noches dan margen suficiente para armar una velada por Aoyama alrededor del trío sin reordenar el resto del itinerario por Kanto.
